subject: Civic Education
lesson: Describes the importance of working with a sense of dignity of labour: Community Observation Checklist & Mapping: Competency 8.6.2
unique_learning_outcome: Describes the importance of working with a sense of dignity of labour.
Explains the benefits gained by working with a sense of dignity of labour.
Presents facts to show that working with a sense of dignity of labour causes job satisfaction.
the_entrance: Detailed 5-minute introduction: teacher and student actions linking prior knowledge to this period topic and activity... Students recall the importance of working with a sense of dignity of labour from the textbook and relate it to their own experiences. Teacher facilitates a brief class discussion on the benefits of working with dignity of labour, highlighting the importance of respect for every worker and developing a sense of pride.

selected_activity:
Activity: Community Observation Checklist & Mapping: Competency 8.6.2
Approach: Students use community observation checklist & mapping to explore 'Describes the importance of working with a sense of dignity of labour.'. Students inspect the provided scenario or accessible surroundings, record evidence, and compare findings. Standard class layout (35 students): Desks arranged into 7 teams (7 teams (7 groups of 5)), with students rotating responsibilities (Leader / Facilitator, Scribe / Secretary, Timekeeper & Logistics, Spokesperson / Presenter, Civic Investigator / Inquirer) without bystanders.
Student task: Students inspect the provided scenario or accessible surroundings, record evidence, and compare findings. Standard class layout (35 students): Desks arranged into 7 teams (7 teams (7 groups of 5)), with students rotating responsibilities (Leader / Facilitator, Scribe / Secretary, Timekeeper & Logistics, Spokesperson / Presenter, Civic Investigator / Inquirer) without bystanders.
Teacher facilitation: Organizes all 35 students using 7 teams (7 groups of 5) with assigned roles: Leader / Facilitator, Scribe / Secretary, Timekeeper & Logistics, Spokesperson / Presenter, Civic Investigator / Inquirer. and monitors progress with outcome-focused prompts and time checks. Circulates across 7 teams, facilitating role execution and formatively checking progress.
Expected output: An evidence record with one supported conclusion.
Grouping: 7 teams (7 groups of 5) with assigned roles: Leader / Facilitator, Scribe / Secretary, Timekeeper & Logistics, Spokesperson / Presenter, Civic Investigator / Inquirer.
